Guard against adding values that count one contribution twice

Source: R/guards.R
pollin_guard_doublecount.Rd

Adds two or more pollin_value() results, draw by draw, after checking that their attributions do not overlap. Each value carries the pollinators its exclusion removed (agent), the product valued and the crop. For values of the same crop the guard refuses

Usage

pollin_guard_doublecount(..., nested = NULL, conf_level = 0.95)

# S3 method for class 'pollin_value_total'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

...

Two or more pollin_value() objects, optionally named.

nested

NULL (the default) or TRUE refuses two different named guilds of one crop; FALSE asserts that their exclusion contrasts are separate and not nested, and allows the sum.

conf_level

Level of the percentile interval of the total.

object

A pollin_value_total object.

Value

An object of class pollin_value_total: a list holding draws (the per-draw total), summary (a one-row data frame with median, conf.low, conf.high, currency, year, n and components), components (the values added), assertion (the statement made by nested = FALSE, or NULL) and conf_level.

Details

  • a part plus its total: a value for agent = "all" with a value for any other agent;

  • the same agent twice for the same product;

  • two products of the same agent, for example seed plus oil: the value of the output already contains the value of the seed;

  • two different named guilds, for example managed plus wild pollinators, unless nested = FALSE asserts that they come from separate, non-nested exclusion contrasts. The assertion is recorded and printed with the total.

A value whose market names no crop is taken to be of the same crop as any other, since the guard cannot rule out the overlap; declare crop in pollin_market(). Agents and products are compared ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

The values must share currency and price year and have the same number of draws. They are added draw by draw, paired by index: values drawn from separate fits are summed as independent, and values read from one pollin_draws() object keep their correlation.

See also

pollin_value().

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(
  trt = rep(rep(c("Cage", "Open"), each = 10L), 8L),
  Site = rep(paste0("s", seq_len(8L)), each = 20L)
)
d$seed <- rgamma(nrow(d), 20, 20 / exp(1 + 0.3 * (d$trt == "Open")))
pd <- pollin_data(d, "seed", "trt", unit = "Site")
ds <- pollin_design(pd, c(excluded = "Cage", open = "Open"), "rcbd")
est <- pollin_estimand(ds, "dependence", "ratio", "loss")
dr <- pollin_draws(pollin_fit(est), n = 2000L, seed = 1L)
canola <- pollin_market(
  12000, 650, "t", "AUD", 2024, "Illustrative inputs", crop = "canola"
)
faba <- pollin_market(
  3000, 400, "t", "AUD", 2024, "Illustrative inputs", crop = "faba bean"
)
# Two crops: no overlap
pollin_guard_doublecount(
  canola = pollin_value(dr, canola, channel = "dependence"),
  faba = pollin_value(dr, faba, channel = "dependence")
)
#> <pollin_value_total>  sum of 2 values 
#>   total      : 2,312,000 AUD (95% interval 1,866,000 to 2,733,000) 
#>   price year : 2024 
#>   draws      : 2000 (added draw by draw, paired by index)
#>   components :
#>     - canola: 2,003,000 AUD; dependence; agent all, product seed, crop canola; source: Illustrative inputs
#>     - faba: 308,200 AUD; dependence; agent all, product seed, crop faba bean; source: Illustrative inputs
# Seed plus oil of one crop is refused
try(pollin_guard_doublecount(
  pollin_value(dr, canola, channel = "dependence", product = "seed"),
  pollin_value(dr, canola, channel = "dependence", product = "oil")
))
#> Error : The values `value 1` and `value 2` are for two products ('seed' and 'oil') attributed to 'all' for the same crop (canola). The value of the processed product already contains the value of the raw one, so adding them counts it again; value one product.
# }
